[size=6]English:[/size][/b]
[size=6]THE COMMAND MUST BE USED IN THE SMAPI CONSOLE[/size]
[size=5]Command: [code]player_pay <User> <Money>
[/code]
Example: [code]player_pay Jorjinho 300
[/code] - deducts 300 from the money of the player executing the command and adds the amount to the player Jorjinho.
[b]

[/b][/size][size=6][b]Portugues:[/b][/size][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][size=6]O COMANDO PRECISA SER UTILIZADO NO CONSOLE DO SMAPI[/size][size=5][b]
[/b]Comando: [code]player_pay <Usuário> <Dinheiro>
[/code]
